gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-numans: Numans runs wide and loose, its s ends drifting off the spine. Bushcraft's closed, marker-smooth forms above it feel sculpted by comparison, while this plain sans keeps a long page of text steady, spacious and easy on the eye.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-onest: Loose, hand-drawn swagger meets tidy lowercase here: Bushcraft spaces its letters far apart, with caps barely taller than the rest. And Onest, a sans-serif with short ascenders and big bowls, holds the text steady, so a modest body size does fine.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-orienta: Bushcraft stretches its letters far apart, with capitals hardly rising above the lowercase and no weight change along any curve. Orienta, a plain sans, sits underneath with open, breathing shapes that make paragraphs feel unhurried.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-oxygen: Smooth, tube-like lines with no thick-and-thin shifts give Bushcraft its odd, inflated charm, and every letter closes itself up tight. Oxygen answers with curves left open and lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, which makes the two feel like opposites sharing a table.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-parkinsans: Playful and wide-spaced, Bushcraft barely separates capitals from lowercase. Its closed shapes meet Parkinsans, a sans-serif with one stroke thickness and wide mouths, and that crisp openness holds up even when text shrinks.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-pathway-extreme: Marker-tip letters, spaced far apart, give Bushcraft a hand-lettered wobble of personality. Pathway Extreme, a sans with stubby ascenders and a big x-height, keeps its rounded openings clear, and extended reading stays tidy and approachable.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-preahvihear: Expressive and wide-spaced, Bushcraft keeps every curve at one thickness. Preahvihear sets a lofty, open-mouthed plain sans beneath it, so the heading's closed forms and the body's breathing room play off each other on the page.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-prompt: Prompt gives small letters an oversized look and wide-open apertures, which makes it easy going in text. Bushcraft's best trick is its soft, featureless hum; this sans simply does legibility.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-pt-sans-caption: Wide-spaced, marker-smooth and a bit eccentric, Bushcraft keeps diagonals as hefty as its stems. PT Sans Caption, a plain sans, does the opposite job, with big-bodied lowercase and unclosed bowls that welcome the eye.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-puritan: Puritan rounds its forms and leaves them open at the side, with oversized e and a counters that feel generous. Under Bushcraft's closed, spread-out heading, this sans-serif keeps paragraphs friendly.
